Holiday minutes, hardworking run
The handlers met at Aurelia Skyways on the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Emil Ali and Samuel Tanaka joined the shift, with Harley waiting calmly nearby.

We checked the board, cleared the handoff notes, and kept the desk ledger current. The team reviewed routine travel support for pets, covering carrier checks, calm greetings, and steady updates for passengers. A few service changes came in, so the record was adjusted at once and the handoff notes were tightened up. Everyone stayed sharp on animal comfort, and the pace stayed brisk without cutting corners.

The group also talked through desk flow, keeping paperwork neat, guiding travelers to the right counter, and making sure each animal got patient attention from trained staff. We agreed the main win is simple follow-through: listen well, note changes fast, and keep the travel path smooth for every pet. No extra issues were raised, and the desk stayed in good order.
